description:
Feature umbrella. Fork wheel 30.35.0.1 is delivered (fork run 45496280726, sha256 703dfcca…), but BenchBox's scheduled sqlglot-delivery job refuses it: scripts/sqlglot_runtime_baseline.json expects `SELECT DATE '2024-01-31' + INTERVAL '1' MONTH` (postgres to sqlite) to be unsupported, and 30.35 now returns the correct 2024-02-29. Adoption therefore needs a person-made PR, and 30.35 cannot certify unattended delivery.

Owner decisions (2026-11-25):
- SQLite older than 3.46 (G2/G3): add an overflow-only guard as a fork generator patch. When the dialect version is below 3.46, a month, quarter or year offset whose base is a DATE literal with day of month 28 or less is emitted without 'floor' (no overflow is possible, so the result is correct); any other month, quarter or year offset raises through self.unsupported(). Other unsupported messages keep their current level. Release it as fork 30.35.0.2 and adopt that instead of 30.35.0.1.
- Version source (G4): sqlite3.sqlite_version from Python's standard library, read at translation time; no new SQLite dependency.
- One BenchBox branch and one PR for: sqlite-pass-engine-version-to-sqlglot, the 30.35.0.2 adoption (vendor wheel, pin, runtime baseline, golden corpus), and the QuestDB pre-pass keep-or-remove decision (questdb-case-prepass-upstream-9193-followup-20261119; v30.35.0 contains upstream d30884dc).
- Delivery is serial: this umbrella is in each member's needs; take it, build on one feature branch, finish it after the PR merges, then take and finish each member.

Order: fork PR with the guard and tests, merged and delivered as 30.35.0.2; then the BenchBox feature PR.

Guardrails: never hand-edit benchbox/_vendor; adopt with the repository's adoption tooling; follow the fork's downstream/MAINTAINING.md for patches.json and staging; no live-cloud runs.
